Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient

endpoint = os.environ["DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT"]
api_key = os.environ["DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY"]

client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(api_key))

with open("invoice.pdf", "rb") as f:
    poller = client.begin_analyze_document("prebuilt-invoice", document=f)
    result = poller.result()

if result.documents:
    fields = result.documents[0].fields
    
    vendor = fields.get("VendorName").value if fields.get("VendorName") else None
    date = fields.get("InvoiceDate").value if fields.get("InvoiceDate") else None
    total = fields.get("InvoiceTotal").value if fields.get("InvoiceTotal") else None
    
    line_items = []
    items_field = fields.get("Items")
    if items_field and items_field.value:
        for item in items_field.value:
            props = item.value
            line_items.append({
                "description": props.get("Description").value if props.get("Description") else None,
                "quantity": props.get("Quantity").value if props.get("Quantity") else None,
                "unit_price": props.get("UnitPrice").value if props.get("UnitPrice") else None,
                "total": (props.get("Total") or props.get("Amount")).value if (props.get("Total") or props.get("Amount")) else None
            })
            
    extracted_data = {
        "vendor": str(vendor) if vendor else None,
        "date": str(date) if date else None,
        "total": float(total) if total else None,
        "line_items": line_items
    }
